Expertise across the North

What we do for businesses & investors

Discuss a brief

Warehouse Leasing

Access our curated network of industrial-grade warehouses across Northern Nigeria — from 500 sqm SME units to 10,000+ sqm bonded facilities.

Warehouse Sales & Acquisition

Buy-side and sell-side representation for industrial assets. Due diligence, title search, structural surveys, and negotiation handled end-to-end.

Facility Management

We manage your industrial or commercial property: tenant relations, rent collection, maintenance, security, and quarterly financial reporting.

Property Valuation

Independent valuations for financing, insurance, portfolio reporting, and litigation — carried out by NIESV-registered professionals.

Site Sourcing & Advisory

Bespoke site searches for build-to-suit developments, logistics hubs, or manufacturing plants — including permits and zoning advisory.

Corporate Real Estate

Office and retail space acquisition, lease negotiation, and portfolio rationalisation for corporate clients operating across the North.

Our process

How we work together, start to finish

01

Discovery

We listen first: your operation, volumes, budget, timing and the non-negotiables.

02

Shortlist

Within days you receive a curated shortlist of verified, personally walked properties.

03

Site visits

We accompany you on inspections and flag what the brochure does not show.

04

Negotiate & close

Fair terms, clean titles, signed paperwork — and we stay on for management if you need it.
